title: DECISION: Canonical stability regression test uses hand-built expected bytes
description: The stability_regression test in core/canonical.rs builds the expected bytes by hand from the format specification, byte by byte, explicitly not from the implementation. The test comment states: 'the expected bytes were computed by hand from the format specification above, not derived from the implementation'. This is an independent oracle. If canonical_bytes() has a bug that would produce different bytes, this test catches it. A future contributor might simplify the test to just verify idempotency (call canonical_bytes twice and compare), which would prove nothing about correctness and would miss any systematic encoding error.
